Home / Records retention policy

Records retention policy

How long the records office keeps each kind of record

Retention schedule

RecordKept for
Registration (Form PR-2) and correctionsThe season plus three years
Responses to solicitations that were not awardedThree years after the award date
Awarded contracts and their responsesSeven years after the contract ends
Certifications lodged by partnersUntil superseded, then three years
Remittance detailsSeven years after the last payment

Records are destroyed at the end of the retention period unless a public records request or litigation hold is pending.
